name: ZCA_SIGNAL_CONSUMERS
description: ZCA_SIGNAL_CONSUMERS: This table will contain topological information related to Signals Consumer registration for use in Spectra OCI.

columns.name: SIGNAL_CONSUMER_ID
columns.description: Auto generated primary key of the table

columns.name: SIGNAL_TOPIC_NAME
columns.description: The Topic Name value which corresponds to the "TopicName" referenced in a Signal Definition Configuration document

columns.name: DELIVERY_TYPE
columns.description: The type of delivery which this consumer registration records corresponds to.  Values may include "WebHook", "Stream", "Queue", etc.

columns.name: DELIVERY_NAME
columns.description: The target name of the delivery implementation.  The usage of this value depends on the delivery type, for example this will be used to store the ONS Logical Topic Name for WebHook delivery type.

columns.name: DELIVERY_ENDPOINT
columns.description: For delivery types that correspond to a physical endpoint, such as "WebHook", store the URN.

columns.name: CONSUMER_DETAILS
columns.description: An optional JSON document used to store subsidiary information required to initiate the runtime connection.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
